package.description: Self-hosted personal AI assistant with persistent memory, scheduled tasks, and sandboxed tools.

en-US.description: Self-hosted personal AI assistant with persistent memory, scheduled tasks, and sandboxed tools.
en-US.longDescription:
Molr is a self-hosted personal AI assistant that runs on your own device and connects to the models you choose. Use the desktop app or a browser on your computer or phone to delegate tasks through ongoing conversations, plan work, and review progress and deliverables in one place. You control each assistant's memory, file access permissions, and budget.
It starts with curiosity. Your personal AI assistant works around the clock and learns from your feedback. Local models are first-class citizens, too: choose cloud or local models, within the permissions and budget you set.
The desktop package is the Molr client and its local Runtime manager. Molr is under active development, so future versions may introduce breaking changes. Exposing the Molr service directly to the public internet is not currently recommended; use it in a secure network environment such as a trusted local network.
en-US.name: Molr
en-US.releaseNotes:
Windows 桌面包未签名，系统可能提示未知发布者或阻止运行。 / Windows desktop installers are unsigned; device security policies may warn or block execution.
What's Changed
- fix: stabilize cross-platform CI and shard WebUI tests by @fcten in https://github.com/molr-ai/molr/pull/4
Full Changelog: https://github.com/molr-ai/molr/compare/v0.2.0...v0.3.0

zh-CN.description: 可自托管的个人 AI 助理，具备持久记忆、定时任务与沙箱化工具。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Molr 是可自托管的个人 AI 助理，在你自己的设备上运行，连接你选择的模型。你可以通过桌面应用或电脑、手机浏览器，用持续对话交代任务，以计划推进执行，并在同一处查看进展与交付结果。每位助理的记忆、资料访问权限和预算都由你管理。
Molr，从好奇出发。你的个人 AI 助理，全天候工作，从你的反馈中学习。本地模型，也是一等公民，自由选择云端或本地模型，在你设定的权限与预算内行动。
桌面安装包包含 Molr 客户端与本机 Runtime 管理器。Molr 仍在持续开发，后续版本也可能包含破坏性变更。目前不建议将 Molr 服务直接暴露到公网，请在可信局域网等安全网络环境中使用。
